zh.title: 对话过程更稳、更省
zh.description: 任务进行中不再反复重新加载整段对话；内容按顺序逐条更新，工具调用再多也不增加加载次数

zh.title: 回复不再跳到别的轮次
zh.description: 每条回复、命令记录和后台通知固定归属到它对应的那条用户消息

zh.title: 运行状态更准
zh.description: “正在运行”和“已结束”直接来自后台的状态通知，停止后立即恢复可输入

zh.title: 切换对话和断线重连更快
zh.description: 已打开过的对话切回时不再重新加载；断线后只补上错过的部分

en.title: Steadier, lighter conversations
en.description: A running task no longer reloads the whole conversation over and over; content updates in order, and more tool calls do not mean more loading

en.title: Replies stay in their turn
en.description: Each reply, command record and background notice stays with the user message it belongs to

en.title: More accurate running state
en.description: Running and finished come straight from the backend's status reports; input is available again as soon as you stop

en.title: Faster switching and reconnecting
en.description: Switching back to an opened conversation no longer reloads it; after a dropped connection only the missed part is read
